description: A customizable link component used to navigate to URLs.

properties.name: customClass
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the link element.

properties.name: href
properties.description: The URL to navigate to when the link is activated.

properties.name: rel
properties.description: The relationship attribute for the link.

properties.name: target
properties.description: The browsing context for the link.

properties.name: underline
properties.description: The underline behavior of the link.

examples.basic:
<modus-wc-link
  color="${args.color}"
  custom-class=${ifDefined(args['custom-class'])}
  href=${ifDefined(args.href)}
  rel=${ifDefined(args.rel)}
  target=${ifDefined(args.target)}
  title=${ifDefined(args.title)}
  underline="${args.underline}"
>Click me</modus-wc-link>
